title.zh: 利率与债券价格 · 利率升，债价跌
title.en: Interest rates & bond prices · rates up, prices down

description.zh: 债券的价格是它未来每一笔票息和本金按当前利率折现后的总和；利率上升，折现变重，旧债券的固定票息就不如新债券，只能降价到买家同样能拿到新利率为止；期限越长，跌得越多。
description.en: A bond’s price is the sum of its future coupons and principal, each discounted at today’s interest rate; when rates rise, discounting gets heavier and an old bond’s fixed coupon falls behind new bonds, so its price must drop until a buyer earns the new rate too; the longer the maturity, the bigger the drop.

aliases.en: why do bond prices fall when rates rise
interest rate risk of long bonds

reason.zh: 现值 PV = FV/(1+r)ᵗ 把复利公式倒过来；把债券的每笔未来现金逐一折现再加总，就是它今天的价格。
reason.en: Present value PV = FV/(1+r)ᵗ runs the compound-interest formula backwards; discount each of a bond’s future payments this way, add them up, and you have its price today.

question.zh: 为什么利率一升，债券价格就跌？
question.en: Why do bond prices fall when interest rates rise?

ask.zh: 5 年后的 1000，利率 5% 和 8% 时今天各值多少？
ask.en: What is 1,000 due in 5 years worth today at 5% and at 8%?

ask.zh: 新债券付 8%，只付 5% 的旧债券还能按 1000 卖出去吗？
ask.en: If new bonds pay 8%, can an old 5% bond still sell for 1,000?

reveal.zh: 债券价格是未来现金按当前利率折现的总和。利率升到 8%，同样的未来现金今天更不值钱；而且新债券付 8%，旧债只付 5%，只有降价到买家也能拿到 8% 才卖得掉。
reveal.en: A bond’s price is its future cash discounted at the current rate. When rates rise to 8%, the same future payments are worth less today; and with new bonds paying 8% against the old one’s 5%, the old bond sells only once its price falls far enough for the buyer to earn 8% as well.
